Probably [he will be out until after the international break].

He has an injury on his thigh and he is going to be a few weeks out.
[Maxence Lacroix] picked up an injury and we expect that he is not going to be ready before the international break.
He’s got a small calf issue… So, we’re not sure about this weekend.

[Nobel Mendy], back in training. Everything is good. So, he will be in the roster for this game.

[Anton Stach] is struggling still a bit with his foot injury… it’s a question mark.
I think they have a chance. They have a chance, but I don’t know for sure if they will be involved or not.
